title: ERP assignment projection
description: The narrow, Control Plane-owned projection of an APPROVED tenant provisioning plan that an ERP workload needs to provision one legal entity (ADR-ERP-002 sections 113 and 114). It carries only facts Control Plane is the authority for: the legal entity's identity and verified profile, the markets the tenant participates in, and the resolved topology (engine, engine instance, isolation profile, capability bindings). It deliberately carries no native placement: which AD_Client or AD_Org a legal entity lands in is an ERP decision (ADR-ERP-021), and no accounting configuration, which a Finance-approved ERP baseline owns (ADR-ERP-008). Per-market currencies, localisation profiles and warehouse codes are not stored by Control Plane, so they are not projected. The projection is read with the erp-assignment:read workload scope; the scope grants no authority over any resource, so Control Plane additionally requires the token's tenant_id to equal the path tenant and the provisioning and legal entity to belong to it. A definition library; validate against the fragment, e.g. erp-assignment.schema.json#/$defs/ErpAssignment.

erpAssignmentMarket.description: A market the tenant participates in, as authorised on its onboarding request.

erpAssignmentBinding.description: A capability bound to the ERP engine instance by the approved plan.

erpAssignmentLegalEntity.description: The legal entity's Control Plane profile (ADR-BCP-018). legal_entity_id is itself the canonical business identifier, so no separate code is projected.

jurisdiction_code.description: The jurisdiction of incorporation as Control Plane records it.

ErpAssignment.description: What Control Plane has decided for one legal entity of one approved tenant provisioning. It is read-only, derived, and bound to the approved plan by plan_digest; ERP validates it against its own request and fails closed on any mismatch (request is not authority).

isolation_profile_id.description: The Control Plane IsolationProfile the engine instance runs under; it constrains, but does not choose, ERP's native placement.

expires_at.description: After this instant ERP must re-read the projection; an expired assignment authorises nothing.
